Design Notes — Identity Lock

  • Pale grey eyes beneath blunt white bangs; the skeletal bone hand and forearm read at a glance.
  • Black kimono in dark wave-pattern brocade; single silver band ring.
  • Bone-white to void — the value range IS the character; never flatten it to mid-grey.
  • Keep the reference's soft dreamy glow, bloom and painterly finish — never flat studio.
  • Pure Edo fantasy; no modern tech.
